headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 16, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies suffered a significant blow as right-handed pitcher Brad Keller was placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right elbow UCL tear, effective retroactive to July 13, 2026. This injury will likely impact the team's pitching rotation in the coming weeks.

Several players across the league have been dealing with injuries, affecting their team's lineups and rotations. The Arizona Diamondbacks' Tommy Troy was placed on the 10-day injured list with a sprained right AC joint, while the Milwaukee Brewers' Rob Zastryzny was transferred to the 60-day injured list with a left trapezius strain. Other notable injuries include Drew Millas of the Washington Nationals, who was placed on the 10-day injured list with a left index finger fracture, and Chris Martin of the Texas Rangers, who was placed on the 15-day injured list with a right shoulder impingement.

The Washington Nationals made a trade, sending center fielder Robert Hassell III to the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for cash. The Milwaukee Brewers also made a significant move, acquiring right-handed pitcher Lance McCullers Jr. and left-handed pitcher Colton Gordon from the Houston Astros in exchange for outfielder Jadyn Fielder. Additionally, the Boston Red Sox acquired outfielder Jahmai Jones from the Detroit Tigers in a trade for a player to be named later.
